versions.content: Every wildcard socket connection shall be reset to wildcard using ReleaseRemoteAddr() if all of the following conditions apply:  The remote address of the socket connection has been set by SD according to SWS_SD_00377.  No Eventgroup Subscription for this socket connection is used anymore.
